_README: LOCAL DEVNET ONLY. Two anvils on 8562/8563 with the deterministic first-deployment addresses. Never point this at a public RPC — it assumes anvil cheat codes and anvil's published dev keys.
_setup: node test/e2e.mjs does all of this automatically. To drive it by hand, follow README.md#run-it-yourself-on-two-anvils; the addresses below are what a fresh anvil produces for the first two deployments from account #0.

chains.name: ferminux-local
chains._notes: 3 confirmations instead of the mainnet 64 so a manual run finishes in seconds. NEVER copy this number into a real config.

limits._note: 20 FMX per transfer, 60 per rolling 24h — deliberately BELOW the 100/500 the contract allows, so the cap-breach path is reachable without touching the chain.

0xe7f1725E7734CE288F8367e1Bb143E90bb3F05._note: wFMX, the wrapper deployed on chain B

submitter._note: Fill these in with the ports the validators printed on startup, or set FMX_RELAYER_PEERS.

_insecure: THIS IS WHY THIS FILE IS DEVNET-ONLY. Each anvil is a single endpoint, so there is no second source to compare against and no eclipse detection is possible — a real config is refused at startup for this shape. Saying so takes the whole acknowledgement sentence on purpose: it cannot be typed by accident, and it stays in the file for the next person to find. Do NOT copy this block into a mainnet config.

insecure.acknowledgement: I understand this disables eclipse protection
insecure._allowCountFinalityWithoutGadget: Both anvils have no finality gadget and no `finality` block, which a real config is refused for: an enabled gadget-less chain must say work-and-time or checkpoint. Devnet only.
